about: House patterns the impeccable detector reports and that are deliberate. Read by scripts/impeccable-scan.js.
A finding is dropped only when every element it points at matches `selector` or sits inside an element that does.
Keep entries narrow: name the element, never switch a whole rule off here. Each one needs a reason that points at DESIGN.md or an owner decision.
Rules the detector can ignore by itself (a whole rule, a font name) go in .impeccable/config.json instead.

allow.reason: The One Standing Glow: the primary button keeps its gold glow at rest (DESIGN.md, Elevation).
Whose-turn and on-deck rows on the initiative board: a state glow, which DESIGN.md allows (The Glow Is State Rule).
The screen-edge cue shown only while it is this viewer's turn: state, not decoration.
The house eyebrow label above a page title (DESIGN.md, Typography).
The same house eyebrow, as the detector names it at desktop width.
Stat tiles, coins, notes and board rows are bordered cells inside a panel: the house panel-in-panel layout.
